props.name: chip_color

props.name: active_color
props.description: Surface of the chosen chip.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Label of an unchosen chip, and the hover tone.

props.name: active_text_color
props.description: Label of the chosen chip.

props.name: size

props.name: gap

props.name: radius

props.name: swell

props.name: barge

props.name: shrink

props.name: jelly

props.name: bounce

props.name: stagger

props.name: stiffness

props.name: disabled

name: LatticeLoader
description: Inline agent-status row: a 3x3 or 4x4 lattice whose cells brighten in a phase-offset wave beside a verb and a live stopwatch, resolving into a check or a cross when the task ends.

props.name: label
props.description: The verb while working.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The verb after status turns to done; the frozen time follows it.

props.name: error_label
props.description: The verb after status turns to error.

props.name: status
props.description: Drives everything: the wave runs, or freezes and dissolves into a check or a cross while the stopwatch stops.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The wave geometry. At 3 x 3: arrow, dots, orbit, ripple, snake, spiral. At 4 x 4: sweep, spin, rain, pulse, orbit, snake. A custom object gives one delay per cell in step units (null for a hole), an optional loop and scale, and lit: the share of the cycle a cell stays bright, 0.25, 0.35, 0.45 or 0.62.

props.name: grid
props.description: Cells per side. Each size has its own set of patterns and its own check and cross.

props.name: shape
props.description: Rounded tiles or dots.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink for the cells, the verb and the stopwatch. Inherits the page colour by default.

props.name: done_color
props.description: Colour of the check.

props.name: error_color
props.description: Colour of the cross.

props.name: cell_size
props.description: Cell side in pixels; the lattice is three cells and two gaps.

props.name: gap
props.description: Seam between cells in pixels.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Verb size in pixels; the stopwatch and row gap scale with it.

props.name: step
props.description: Milliseconds between neighbouring cells lighting; the whole loop scales with it.

props.name: idle_opacity
props.description: How visible the dark silhouette is.

props.name: glow
props.description: A halo on the lit cells and the mark.

props.name: glow_color
props.description: The halo colour. Empty follows the ink, and the mark colour for the mark.

props.name: show_timer
props.description: Shows the live stopwatch.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Controlled elapsed seconds. When set, the internal clock never runs.

name: PeekRating
description: Star rating you can try before you commit: sweeping the row lifts a trailing wave of stars up to the pointer while a tip hops along with the label; a click commits with a pop.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rating, from 0 to count.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial rating when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called when a rating is committed by click, release or keyboard.

props.name: on_preview
props.description: Called on every slot crossing while previewing, and with null when the preview clears.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of glyphs.

props.name: shape
props.description: Built-in glyph shape.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom glyph that replaces the built-in shape.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per glyph, shown in the tip while previewing. Without labels the tip shows the number.

props.name: active_color
props.description: Colour of lit glyphs and of the focus ring.

props.name: idle_color
props.description: Colour of unlit glyphs.

props.name: tip_color
props.description: Background of the tip that follows the pointer.

props.name: tip_text_color
props.description: Text colour of the tip.

props.name: size
props.description: Glyph size in pixels; spacing and the tip scale with it.

props.name: lift
props.description: How far previewed glyphs rise, in pixels. 0 makes the preview colour-only.

props.name: magnify
props.description: Scale of the glyph under the pointer.

props.name: rise_duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of each glyph’s rise and fall, and of the tip’s hop.

props.name: pop_scale
props.description: Peak scale of the pop on the committed glyph. 1 disables it.

props.name: show_tip
props.description: Shows the tip above the pointer glyph while previewing.

props.name: allow_clear
props.description: Clicking the current rating again, or Backspace, clears it to 0.

props.name: read_only
props.description: Display only: no preview, no pop, announced as an image.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the control and ignores input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the radio group.

name: PromptBar
description: Chat composer with an @ sources menu, a / commands menu, a model picker, dictation and attachments, whose send tile charges to ink the moment there is something to send and morphs its arrow into a stop square while busy.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field is empty.

props.name: sources
props.description: Rows of the @ menu and the plus button: key, name, description, icon (a Hugeicons icon or any node), and attach: true for the row that adds files.

props.name: commands
props.description: Rows of the / menu: key, name (with the slash), description.

props.name: models
props.description: Rows of the model picker: key, name, tag. An empty list hides the picker.

props.name: default_model
props.description: Key of the model selected at first. Empty picks the first.

props.name: efforts
props.description: Steps of the effort slider, low to high. The last step turns the field to the spark colour with drifting sparks. An empty list hides the control.

props.name: default_effort
props.description: The step selected at first. Empty picks the middle.

props.name: on_effort_change
props.description: The slider moved.

props.name: busy
props.description: A response is in flight. The send tile stays ink and its arrow morphs into a stop square.

props.name: on_send
props.description: Enter or the tile, with a non-empty draft or an attachment. The draft and attachments clear.

props.name: on_stop
props.description: The tile while busy.

props.name: on_attach
props.description: Picked the attach row. Return file names, or a promise of them, and they appear as chips.

props.name: on_dictate
props.description: The mic. Return the transcript, or a promise of it, and it lands in the draft. Omit to hide the mic.

props.name: background
props.description: The field surface, and the glyph on an armed tile.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink: text, icons, and the armed tile.

props.name: menu_background
props.description: The surface of the menus and the effort popover.

props.name: spark_color

props.name: width

props.name: radius

props.name: max_rows

props.name: morph_duration

props.name: tilt
props.description: Mid-morph lean in degrees, mirrored on the way back.

props.name: press_scale
props.description: Scale of the send tile while a pointer is down.

name: PulseHeart
description: Like button that contracts to a dot, flips colour at its smallest frame and pulses back while the count swaps one glyph.

props.name: liked

props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled.

props.description: The number shown; a press adds or removes one. Rolls one glyph per press. For a multi-digit odometer with places and decimals, use Counter.

props.name: icon

props.name: text_color

props.name: overshoot

props.name: beat

props.name: roll_duration
props.description: How long the changed glyph of the count takes to roll, in milliseconds.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the button and ignores input.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the count is appended to it.

name: RefineFrame
description: Reserved-aspect frame that walks any media through queued, generating, refining and complete without layout shift: each stage is one blur, saturate, scale and opacity tween, a soft band sweeps while it works, a chip reports the stage, and an error dims the picture behind a retry pill.

props.name: status
props.description: The stage. Each change tweens the media to that stage.

props.name: aspect_ratio
props.description: The box reserved before and during generation, so nothing shifts.

props.name: width
props.description: Frame width in px, capped at the parent.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px.

props.name: background
props.description: The paper behind the media, and the chip surface.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink: chip text, the sweep and the retry pill.

props.name: stage_duration
props.description: Each stage tween, in ms.

props.name: sweep
props.description: A soft band crosses the frame while it works.

props.name: show_status
props.description: The chip with the mark and the stage label.

props.name: hide_after
props.description: Ms after completion before the chip fades. 0 keeps it.

props.name: labels
props.description: Chip text per stage: Queued, Generating, Refining, Ready, Failed.

props.name: retry_label
props.description: The pill on an error.

props.name: on_retry
props.description: The retry pill was pressed. Without it, no pill.

name: RubberSegment
description: Segmented control with a rubber thumb: taps stretch it across the gap and squash it onto the target, and you can grab, drag and flick it between slots.

props.name: items
props.description: The slots, in order. A string is both value and label.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. A change from outside jumps the thumb without animation.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled; the first item if omitted.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on a tap, on a drag release and on every arrow key.

props.name: track_color
props.description: The well behind the slots.

props.name: thumb_color
props.description: The rubber thumb, and the focus ring.

props.name: text_color
props.description: Idle labels, drawn at 70%.

props.name: active_text_color
props.description: The label revealed inside the thumb.

props.name: size
props.description: Track height 28, 36 or 44 pixels; font and padding follow.

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius in pixels.

props.name: inset
props.description: Gap between the thumb and the track edge; the thumb corner is radius minus inset.

props.name: equal_slots
props.description: Every slot the same width. Off, slots hug their labels and the thumb changes width per slot.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far a tap dilates the thumb across old and new slot before it contracts. 0 is a plain slide.

props.name: squash
props.description: Pixels the trailing edge lands past the slot edge before relaxing. 0 removes the squash.

props.name: speed
props.description: Scales every phase together; 0.25 is slow motion.

props.name: glide
props.description: How far a flick carries the thumb before it snaps. 0 always lands on the nearest slot.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the thumb be grabbed, dragged and flicked.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the control and ignores input.

name: ScrubField
description: Number chip you drag to scrub: the value follows the hand, pushes past the range on a rubber band, and a click without moving opens it for typing.

props.name: label
props.description: The field name. Drag anywhere on the chip to scrub; click without moving to type.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Unit after the number, also read by screen readers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; changes from outside land without motion.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value and the dirty baseline: the ring turns off exactly here.

props.name: min
props.description: Lower bound; the rubber band starts here.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper bound; the rubber band starts here.

props.name: step
props.description: Granularity of drag and arrows; sets the decimals shown.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip height 28, 34 or 44 pixels.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Pixels of travel per step. 1 is twitchy, 6 is precise.

props.name: rubber_reach
props.description: How far past a bound the number can be pushed, as a percent of the range. 0 is a hard stop.

props.name: return_duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of the critically damped snap back to the bound.

props.name: coarse_multiplier
props.description: Step multiplier while Shift is held, and for Page Up and Page Down.

props.name: fine_multiplier
props.description: Step multiplier while Alt or Option is held; adds a decimal.

props.name: show_delta
props.description: Shows the signed change in a pill riding the pointer.

props.name: show_dirty
props.description: Rings the chip while the value differs from the default.

props.name: show_fill
props.description: Fills the chip from the left in proportion to where the value sits in the range.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill band, dirty ring and delta pill.

props.name: chip_color
props.description: Chip surface. Text inherits from the page.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the chip and ignores input.

props.description: Called on every step, key and typed commit.

props.name: on_commit
props.description: Called on release, on a key step and on blur or Enter.

name: SlideCommit
description: Slide-to-confirm handle that plants with a spinner while your action runs, unfurls into a done pill on success and springs home with a squash and shake on failure.

props.name: label
props.description: The instruction centred in the pill; the capsule wipes it as you drag.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The words beside the check once confirmed.

props.name: error_label
props.description: Replaces the instruction, in the danger colour, after a rejected promise.

props.name: on_confirm
props.description: Called when the handle reaches the end. Return a promise to show the spinner; it unfurls on resolve and springs home on reject.

props.name: on_done
props.description: Called when the done pill unfurls.

props.name: on_error
props.description: Called with the rejection reason; the component swallows it otherwise.

props.name: track_color
props.description: The pill behind the handle.

props.name: handle_color
props.description: The handle and the ground it paints; the arrow colour is picked to read on it.

props.name: success_color
props.description: Fill of the done pill.

props.name: danger_color
props.description: Tint of the handle and error label after a reject.

props.name: width
props.description: Track width in pixels; the travel scales with it.

props.name: height

props.name: radius
props.description: Track corner radius; the handle corner is 4px smaller so the two stay concentric.

props.name: speed
props.description: How fast the unfurl and the return take over once you let go.

props.name: return_bounce

props.name: landing_dip

props.name: disabled

props.name: icon

name: SlingButton
description: Send button you pull back like a slingshot: the band stretches, a power arc arms it, and releasing fires the action with the flick's velocity.

props.name: on_send
props.description: Called on a loaded release, on a tap when tapSends is on, and on Enter or Space.

props.name: pad_color

props.name: icon_color

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The power arc, the loaded band and the dot.

props.name: well_color

props.name: band_color

props.name: size

props.name: stroke_width

props.description: How far the band can stretch before it stops giving.

props.name: axis

props.description: Called when any action button is pressed.

props.name: on_commit
props.description: Called after a full swipe or a press on a folding action, once the row has shut. Remove the row here.

props.name: close_on_action
props.description: Closes the drawer after an action is pressed.

props.name: haptic
props.description: A short vibration on touch when the block leaps.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the row.

name: SwipeToast
description: Single toast that rises through its bottom edge, swipes down to dismiss on a flick or a distance, and burns a thin fuse for exactly its remaining time; hover pauses it and an inline mode keeps it inside any container.

props.name: title
props.description: The first line.

props.name: description
props.description: The dimmer second line. Empty hides it.

props.name: icon
props.description: An 18px icon before the text.

props.name: action_label
props.description: The inverted button. Empty hides it.

props.name: on_action
props.description: Called when the action is pressed, before the close.

props.name: open
props.description: Flip to false to close from outside. True again re-enters.

props.name: on_close
props.description: Called after the exit, and after the inline slot has collapsed. Reason is timeout, swipe, action, close, escape or programmatic.

props.name: background
props.description: The card surface, and the action text.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink: title, description at 62% and the action fill.

props.name: fuse_color
props.description: The burning line.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width in pixels, capped at the parent when inline.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in pixels.

props.name: slide_ms
props.description: How long the rise and the drop take.

props.name: settle_bounce
props.description: Overshoot of the return after an abandoned swipe. 0 stops dead.

props.name: swipe_distance
props.description: How far a slow drag must go before release dismisses. A flick always does.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds until it closes itself. Changing it re-arms the fuse. 0 keeps it until dismissed.

props.name: fuse
props.description: Which edge the line burns along. None keeps the timer but shows nothing.

props.name: pause_on_hover
props.description: Hovering freezes the line and the timer.

props.name: close_button
props.description: Adds a cross at the end of the row.

props.name: inline
props.description: In flow inside the parent instead of fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Off removes the swipe and Escape.

props.title: File archived
props.description: Moved to Archive

name: ThoughtLine
description: Reasoning-trace header: a glyph and a label breathe beside a live clock while steps appear beneath, then the line settles on one beat into "Thought for 4.2s" through a blur crossfade and the trace folds into it.

props.name: label
props.description: The working line. It breathes, and it is the spoken text.

props.name: done_label
props.description: The settled line. Empty gives "Thought for", or "Done thinking" without the timer.

props.name: render_label
props.description: Wraps either string, for a sheen or a link. Inline content only.

props.name: glyph
props.description: The mark that breathes and dims.

props.name: steps
props.description: The trace beneath the line. Append as the agent progresses; the last step is current, earlier ones tick.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: The line becomes a toggle for the trace, with a chevron.

props.name: collapse_on_settle
props.description: Fold the trace into the line when it settles.

props.name: color
props.description: The ink of the line and the trace.

props.name: glyph_color
props.description: The glyph alone. Empty follows the ink.

props.name: font_size
props.description: Type size in px. Everything scales in em.

props.name: breath_period
props.description: One breath, up and down, in seconds.

props.name: breath_depth
props.description: How far the glyph and label dim at the trough. 0 is no breath.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: A band of ink sweeps the working label. The label then leaves the breath to the glyph.

props.name: shimmer_duration
props.description: One sweep, in seconds.

props.name: settle_duration
props.description: The settle chord, in ms: crossfade, dim, glide, fold.

props.name: settle_blur
props.description: Blur through the crossfade seam, in px.

props.name: working
props.description: Working or settled. True again starts a new clock.

props.name: settle_after
props.description: Seconds after which the line settles by itself. 0 waits for working.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Controlled seconds. The internal clock never runs.

props.name: show_timer
props.description: The live clock that freezes into the sentence.

props.name: on_settle
props.description: Once per settle, with the frozen time.

name: VoicePill
description: Mic button that swells into a tinted capsule of level-driven equalizer bars and an elapsed clock while held or toggled, then relaxes back into the mic on release; simulated voice by default, real microphone as an opt-in.

props.name: accent_color
props.description: The waveform, the clock and the stop mark.

props.name: icon_color
props.description: The mic at rest, and the hover wash.

props.name: background
props.description: The capsule surface.

props.name: size
props.description: Footprint in px. The icon, the stop mark and the clock scale with it.

props.name: shape
props.description: A circle that opens into a capsule, or a rounded square.

props.name: reach
props.description: The room the capsule leaves before the waveform, in px.

props.name: show_time
props.description: An elapsed clock in the capsule, which grows to the left to hold it.

props.name: waveform
props.description: A history of the level scrolling through the capsule, past the clock.

props.name: slide_to_cancel
props.description: While held, sliding left drags the capsule contents along and reveals Cancel. Crossing the distance scatters the bars and stops without a result.

props.name: cancel_distance
props.description: How far left a held pointer slides before it cancels, in px.

props.name: attack
props.description: How fast the level rises to a louder signal, in ms.

props.name: release
props.description: How long the level hangs after the sound drops, in ms.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: Gain on the signal before the envelope.

props.name: floor
props.description: Waveform bar height when silent, as a fraction of its box.

props.name: open_duration
props.description: The capsule open and close, in ms.

props.name: press_scale
props.description: Scale of the button while a pointer is down.

props.name: mode
props.description: Auto: a tap latches, a hold stops on release. Hold: release always stops. Toggle: release never stops.

props.name: hold_after
props.description: In auto, the press length after which a release stops instead of latching, in ms.

props.name: reactive
props.description: What drives the level. Mic asks for microphone permission on the first press and stops if it is refused.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dimmed and inert. A listening pill stops.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name. The state is carried by aria-pressed.

props.name: on_start
props.description: Listening began, with the requested source.

props.name: on_stop
props.description: Listening ended. Reason is release, tap, key, escape, blur, cancel, disabled, mic-denied or unmount; duration in ms.

name: WakeSlider
description: Range slider drawn as thin bars with no thumb: drag speed raises a wake that trails behind the handle and flattens again at rest.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value.

props.name: default_value
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: on_change
props.description: Called on every committed change, from the pointer or the keyboard.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value.

props.name: step
props.description: Snapping grid. Large steps move the handle in notches, and the wake pulses per notch.

props.name: bars
props.description: How many bars draw the track.

props.name: height
props.description: Full bar height in pixels, the ceiling of the wake.

props.name: rest_height
props.description: Bar height at rest in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between bars in pixels.

props.name: fill_color
props.description: Lit bars, up to the value.

props.name: track_color
props.description: Unlit bars.

props.name: crest_color
props.description: Optional tint the raised bars take on by their lift. Empty renders no tint layer.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: How easily speed raises the wake. Low needs a flick; high lifts it on a stroll.

props.name: reach
props.description: Half-width of the wake at full speed, in bars.

props.name: skew
props.description: How much wider the wake is behind the handle than ahead. 0 is symmetric.

props.name: glide
props.description: Seconds the handle takes to settle. Short hugs the finger; long floats behind it.

props.name: smoothing
props.description: Milliseconds of velocity lag. Low twitches with every change of speed; high lingers.

props.name: show_value
props.description: Shows the value beside the track.

props.name: format_value
props.description: Formats the readout and the announced value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Fades the slider and ignores input.

props.name: aria_label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider.

name: WarmTooltip
description: Tooltip group with one shared delay: the first label waits and pops from its trigger, then siblings open instantly while the group is warm, with an optional velocity lean.

props.name: content
props.description: The label. Keep it to a few words.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Optional keyboard shortcut, drawn as a keycap beside the label.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge the label hangs from; also where the fuse runs and the pop originates.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a cold open waits, in milliseconds. Inherits the group value when omitted.

props.name: warm_window
props.description: How long after this label closes the group stays warm. Inherits the group value when omitted.

props.name: surface_color
props.description: Label background, arrow and fuse.

props.name: ink_color
props.description: Label text; the keycap is tinted from it.

props.name: size
props.description: Font size and padding of the label.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the label in pixels.

props.name: gap
props.description: Distance between the trigger edge and the label.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows the pointer on the anchored edge.

props.name: pop_duration
props.description: Cold pop-in time in milliseconds; the exit takes 0.8 of it.

props.name: pop_scale
props.description: Scale the label pops from. 1 makes it a fade.

props.name: pop_blur
props.description: Blur in pixels the label arrives through.

props.name: show_fuse
props.description: Draws a thin line along the trigger edge that fills over the delay, or over the long press on touch.

props.name: long_press
props.description: Hold time in milliseconds that opens the label on touch; the click that follows is swallowed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: No open path; an open label closes.

name: WarmTooltip
description: Groups WarmTooltips so moving between them skips the open delay.

props.name: delay
props.description: Open delay in ms.

props.name: warm_window
props.description: How long (ms) the group stays warm.
